errors.evidence: The y-axis range shown on the chart is 0% to 15%, not 0% to 13.8%. 13.8% is the peak data value, not the end of the axis range.
The labeled tick marks on the y-axis are at 0, 5, 10, and 15, representing increments of 5%, not 1%.

errors.text_span: The first line, colored in red, traces a decreasing trend from a value of approximately 7% in 1960, to a value around 9.4% in 1980, before increasing to approximately 12.8% by 2010.
errors.evidence: This sentence completely misrepresents the single line on the chart. The value in 1960 was 12.8%, not 7%. The value in 2010 was 7%, not 12.8%. The value in 1980 was 12.1%, not 9.4%. The trend is also described incorrectly; the line increases slightly from 1960 to 1970 and then steadily decreases to 2010.

errors.text_span: A second line, colored in green, begins at approximately 11.0% in 2000 and steadily decreases to approximately 12.1% by 2010.
errors.evidence: The chart contains only one red line. This entire sentence describes a second, green line that does not exist.
